Key Features:

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.

_Hey all, your average plugin developer rewriting their entire plugin every few months here with some exciting news.. I've rewritten GoodFriend from scratch!_

**:warning: Please note that upon updating to the new version, your configuration will be completely wiped as it is no longer compatible. You will also be unable to send events or receive events with your friends using the older version.**

## What's changed?

A new modular design has been used when rewriting so that new functionality can be added in the future with less development work. All the existing functionality of the plugin has been re-implemented already so you shouldn't notice anything missing.

Thanks to this new design, you can now toggle each module on/off independently so that you only have the functionality that you actually want to have.

The interface has also been completely redesigned to clearly show each module as well as plugin-wide configuration options. At the very least, I think it looks better (I'm not a UI/UX designer)

### New Modules

- Login State Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list log in or log out with customizable filtering to only catch the notifications you want to see. (As this is the old functionality of the plugin this module has been enabled by default)

- World Change Notifications: Get notified when other people using GoodFriend on your in-game friends list change worlds using the world visit system while logged in with filtering to only see when people visit your own world (Disabled by default, still being improved as of now)

### Bug Fixes

- Too many to list here, but most of the fixes are related to connectivity problems.

Let me know what you think in either the `#plugin-testing` channel or the GoodFriend plugin thread! Thanks in advance to the plugin reviewers that have to review this as well.

plugins.Author: tesu
plugins.Name: Penny Pincher
plugins.Punchline: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices
plugins.Description:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.  

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.

plugins.Author: GitHixy
plugins.Name: LootView
plugins.Punchline: See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.
plugins.Description:
LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

Works with every game language: English, Japanese, German and French.

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Currency drawer beside the overlay with every currency you hold, its cap and the weekly tomestone limit.
- A banner on screen when another player commends you.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner. Roll Need, Greed or Pass right from the panel, with the game's own loot window kept out of the way.
- Collectibles you already have (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles, portrait frames) are marked on their icon.
- Detailed item tooltips with item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots and market price.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any item to try it on, look it up, copy its name or blacklist it.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVACY

Your history is stored locally in your Dalamud configuration folder and is never uploaded. Market prices are looked up from universalis.app and loot tables from garlandtools.org; both requests send only an item or duty ID. Price lookups can be turned off in the settings.

plugins.Author: Juan Medina
plugins.Name: It's Up
plugins.Punchline: Yes. Still up. Press it.
plugins.Description:
Doing your rotation is hard enough without having to stare at your hotbars. This plugin helps you know exactly when an ability you actually care about is back up.

We don't want to clutter your screen with a massive status board. This won't show you everything that's currently available—instead, it stays completely empty until you use an ability in combat. Once you spend it and it comes off cooldown, the icon pops up to remind you. Press it, and it's gone again.

Because it only reminds you about things you've already used, it won't spam your screen before a pull. And for abilities with charges, it only pings when you go from 0 to 1—if you're sitting on a charge, it stays out of your way since you can already press it.

It's perfect for those key rotational abilities you really don't want to drift. You can also configure each ability so the reminder stays on screen until you press it, or quietly disappears after a few seconds.

/itsup → Open settings.
/itsup move → Unlock the bar to reposition it.
/itsup preview → Toggle preview mode.
/itsup reset → Reset the bar position and size.

This is a pretty big update. The directory now includes community events, Party Finder venue ads, notifications, and quite a few changes to how venues are displayed and filtered.

- Added a new Events tab. It shows FFXIV community events posted on Partake for the next two weeks, with filters for time, age rating, tags and location. You can also mark events with "I'm going" if you plan to attend.
- Party Finder venue ads collected by xivpf.com can now appear alongside events, as well as directly on the matching venue's page.
- Venues don't necessarily have to be listed on FFXIV Venues anymore. If a venue has an event on Partake or is currently advertising in Party Finder, it can still appear in the directory.
- Venue pages now show their upcoming events and any Party Finder ads that are currently active.
- Added optional notifications for favorite venues and events. The plugin can notify you when a favorite venue opens, when an event at a favorite venue starts, or 15 minutes before an event you've marked as going to. These notifications still work while the directory window is closed.
- Added "My data center" filtering. It follows the data center your current character is actually on, including after Data Center Travel. Location filters are remembered separately for each character.
- If you're standing on the plot of a listed venue, or you're already inside it, the top bar now tells you which venue you're at and gives you a quick way to mark it as visited.
- You can now hide venues you're not interested in. There's an undo option in the top bar, and hidden venues can always be found again with the Hidden filter.
- Venue descriptions now keep much more of their original formatting, including headings, bold and italic text, lists, links and images. Animated GIF, WebP and APNG images are supported too. Images in descriptions are only loaded over HTTPS and can be turned off in settings.
- Banners and images can optionally be enlarged by hovering over them. This is disabled by default.
- Locations outside the housing districts can now be opened on the in-game map.
- Settings have been moved into their own window and split into separate pages for appearance, images, events and notifications. There's also an About page with the changelog. You can use the directory's own theme or your Dalamud theme, change the UI size, and choose between a 12- or 24-hour clock.
- Schedule handling has been reworked. The directory now tries to show each venue's next actual opening in your local timezone instead of just displaying the raw weekly schedule. Monthly schedules, breaks, one-off openings and active venue notices are supported, and openings more than a week away show the date as well.
- Venue names and descriptions now show many more symbols and stylized letters; characters the game can't draw are replaced with plain letters instead of showing as boxes.
- Added a clearer error message for cases where FFXIV Venues refuses requests from your network or region.

plugins.Author: The Redheaded Witch & WillWolf76
plugins.Name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
plugins.Punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!
plugins.Description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.

plugins.Punchline: Open web pages, wikis, and Lodestone articles in your browser directly from your chat bar.
plugins.Description:
Inspired by the /wiki command from Guild Wars 2, Gubal lets you open web pages in your browser straight from the in-game chat bar. Named after the Great Gubal Library, just type a slash command followed by what you're looking for to jump directly to specific guides, item pages, and articles in your default browser.
            
            Commands and Examples:
            
            /wiki [query] - Search the FFXIV Console Games Wiki (opens in browser):
            - /wiki great gubal library (opens The Great Gubal Library dungeon guide)
            - /wiki sightseeing log (opens the Sightseeing Log guide)
            - /wiki relic weapons (opens the Relic Weapon progression guide)
            - /wiki blue mage spells (opens the Blue Mage spell list)
            
            /lodestone [query] - Search the official Lodestone (opens in browser):
            - /lodestone patch 7.56 (opens the Patch 7.56 notes directly)
            - /lodestone maintenance (opens latest server maintenance notices)
            - /lodestone eorzea database excalibur (opens official item details)
            - /lodestone community finder (opens the Community Finder)
            
            /gubal - Open the configuration window to add, edit, or customize search commands with the {text} placeholder.
